# HFL Global Tech

HFL Global Tech is the technology organisation within the HFL ecosystem. Legal name: HFL Global Technologies Private Limited.

Tagline: Technology built for real-world use.

Focus: Super Intelligence, AI agents, software engineering, automation, cybersecurity and digital innovation.

Flagship: AgentMesh — an agent orchestration system organised around Context, Tools, Evaluation and Human Control. The public browser reference runtime currently reports 6/6 deterministic self-tests passing.

Status: Building in public.

Status labels: DEMONSTRATED, IN DEVELOPMENT, LONG-TERM RESEARCH.

Long-term direction: Flux AI, focused on coding, reasoning and automation research.

Evidence policy: HFL Global Tech separates demonstrated implementations from development and research. Comparative performance, cost, customer and market-leadership claims are shown only when supported by verified evidence.
